bid_status.description: `bid` when the opportunity was actually pursued, else `logged_no_bid` (a tenant may log every opportunity, including no-bids).

customer.description: The customer entity anchor, when the source row names a contact company/number.

estimator.description: The internal estimator assigned to the pursuit.

external_id.description: The tenant's own opportunity number, unique per source company; the fact's natural key.

financial_period.description: The financial period the event falls in.

jurisdiction.description: AU state/territory the opportunity is in, matched from the title text.

legal_entity.description: The BC company that owns the opportunity.

occurred_at.description: The episodic event time: source creation date, falling back to last-modified then close date.

project.description: The project/job anchor, when one resolves.

salesperson.description: Name of the source-system opportunity owner.

source_system.description: Which bound system produced the event.

title.description: Human identity of the opportunity, truncated to 500 characters.

value.x-demiton-unit: currency of the `CURRENCY` axis (AUD for the BC binding)

work_type_id.description: The org's classification of the work, from the shared `work_types.yaml` catalogue.

work_type_source.description: Provenance of the classification (keyword vs LLM path).

standards.edition: 2019/1780 as amended by 2023/2884 (applies 1 Jun 2024; Annex 1 Nov 2024)
standards.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/1780 standard forms for procurement notices, as amended by (EU) 2023/2884
